# Authoritative per-block-state block-entity-type census for protocol 776 (Minecraft 26.2).
#
# Produced by booting the real 26.2 server headlessly and, for every state in
# Block.BLOCK_STATE_REGISTRY, finding the registered BlockEntityType whose
# validBlocks set claims that state (BlockEntityType.isValid, 26.2
# BlockEntityType.java:26-28) — the same set the block was registered with and
# therefore the same answer EntityBlock.newBlockEntity would give, without
# constructing 32k live BlockEntity objects. Generator:
# crates/lodestone-data/oracle-java/BlockEntityTypeOracle.java, run via the
# temurin:25-jdk Docker classpath (see tests/block_entity_types.rs docs).
#
# The oracle throws rather than emitting a row when a state that reports
# hasBlockEntity() is claimed by other than exactly one type, or when a state
# that reports no block entity is claimed by any — so this file existing at all
# is evidence both invariants held across all 32,366 states.
#
# One line per state, ascending global state id:
#   <stateId> <blockName> <blockEntityTypeId | -1> <blockEntityTypeName | ->
#
